scope: custom C++17 engine-first; no UE migration or paused content restart

current_repair.covered_subrequirement: bounded wireframe input validation only, not all of E03

active_candidates.covered_subrequirement: separate Win32 editor frame with toolbar, Outliner, procedural viewport, Inspector and primitive asset browser; unsupported Select/Move/Rotate/Scale/Play actions stay disabled; toolbar and panel child-control geometry are deterministic and contained within their assigned regions across standard, narrow, short, zero and malformed tested client extents; viewport GDI paint is clipped to the deterministic viewport rectangle during extreme resize; rectangle containment/overlap edges and toolbar/panel/status coordinate offsets avoid signed-int overflow in tested INT_MIN/INT_MAX-adjacent cases by promoting arithmetic before range-clamped conversion; editor message-loop result handling distinguishes dispatch, normal WM_QUIT, and GetMessage error, and fails with a nonzero exit on retrieval error; all 12 required E11 editor child controls must be created before UI initialization continues, and any missing required control causes WM_CREATE to fail closed; no scene mutation or serialization

progression_rules: No completion from docs, stubs, test counts or green compilation.
Research one dependency-ready gap, reproduce or specify a failure, then implement one bounded packet.
Keep native and independent acceptance gates; staged repairs are not auto-merged.
Record source SHA, commands, exits, versions, files, hashes and deferred local checks.
No second local scheduler, local process control or publication from this record.
Advance after acceptance and stop/resume honestly at external gates.
